coverage.rationale: All declared scientific scope assessed; no established material false claim or required-scope omission. Unreported BagIt writer/profile limits, underspecified historical test conditions and minor dating/option wording prevent FULL_PASS.
coverage.scope_frozen_before_judgment: Original brief O1-O6 and original P1-P6 decisions; final owner choices and complete semantic/rendered content.
coverage.count_definition: complete means inventory size; assessed means review completed, not that a candidate assertion was proven. Groups overlap; only obligations_total_excluding_rollups sums O1-O6 + 35 atomic plan decisions + 12 owner decisions.

axes.name: Original brief and all plan/owner obligations
Consequential claims, definitions, versions and applicability
Bounded discovery, mechanisms, alternatives, negatives and opportunities
Incorrect rejection/correction or false already-covered disposition
Proposed versus executed validation and witness applicability

O1.assessment: Brief-led discovery: institutional ingest analogy, FFprobe/FFmpeg, BWF MetaEdit, BagIt and PREMIS; useful negative and optional findings; no exhaustive opportunity claim.

O2.assessment: Immutable bagit-python code, governing definitions and callers support the authored mechanisms; unreported 0.97 writer/profile and conformance limits constrain the 1.0 reference candidate.

O3.assessment: Real #152 report, PR #184, merge, released tag and inspected tests establish history; exact automated regression absent and proposed test environment is underspecified.

O4.assessment: All six sections and all 35 atomic decisions compared; already-covered claims stay within supplied P1-P6.

O5.assessment: Admitted substantive critique independently checked and all nine final criticism dispositions assessed; family/dispatch provenance is host-only under review instructions.

O6.assessment: Coherent complete proposed replacement, options, rejections, validation and uncertainty; minor optional-record/digest wording ambiguity, no build or validation claim.

decisions.obligation: Local desktop ingest of selected WAV/BWF, FLAC and MP3 from removable media
Preserve filenames and relative folder structure
Explicit user request for listening derivative
No embedded metadata changes for display
No recipe, component-version or preservation-quality validation asserted

owner_decisions.decision: Target sample rate, bit depth, filters, channel and metadata maps
Collision/unsupported path resolution and reversible mapping
Exact metadata whitelist and correction fields
Formal event record and local subset versus full PREMIS

host_only_not_adjudicated: Provider/family and dispatch identity, activation/terminal lifecycle, timing/quota/economics and billing. The original O5 family wording is recorded, not certified from self-authored metadata.
boundary_disclosure: Only own-arm named scientific artifacts and public primary sources used for judgment.

Also read adjacent own-arm research semantic.json (byte-identical to admitted embedded input) and research preservation_check.md; the latter self-report is excluded as scientific/preservation truth. No other arm/case/parent/campaign-state/review contents read.
blinding_limits: Visible renderer/procedure/Goal metadata can reveal method differences.
Author timing/counters ignored; no counterpart outputs, scores, cost/speed targets or parent analysis used.
